in_marathi.name: Ashpak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashpak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashpak is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'ashva' meaning horse and 'pak' meaning to ride or to protect. This name is associated with warriors who ride horses into battle, symbolizing strength, courage, and protection.
